paragraphs.text: The following Arcavian characters are only mentioned in flavor text or on legendary creature cards, appear as minor characters in the storyline , or are otherwise not notable enough to receive their own article.

Anina is a human wizard Quandrix student. A graduate student with a particular interest in hydra -like creatures , Anina has spent her studies focused on how the natural world repeats and reflects itself, much like fractals . She is confident that in studying theoretical manifestations in the real world, she will be better able to hone her craft and construct increasingly elaborate creatures.
Anina, Natural Parallelist

Arnyn is a vampire druid and Witherbloom student specializing in the care and cultivation of carnivorous plants , Arnyn has developed several new species of flora. They are particularly interested in understanding the methods carnivorous plants use to consume flesh and absorb life energy in comparison to vampires. Their current practicum at Titan's Grave has explored the effects of different kinds of pests on native carnivorous flora's development, intent on discerning their nutritional value.
Arnyn, Deathbloom Botanist

Aziza is a djinn and star athlete, Aziza is the captain of the Lorehold Mage Tower team and the intramural Strixhaven team. Born between c. 4543 and 4546. Aziza has dedicated herself to studying fieldwork methodologies, complementing her active and energetic lifestyle.
Aziza, Mage Tower Captain
Practiced Offense ( Secrets of Strixhaven )

Berta is a burrog druid and Quandrix professor. She spends most of her time in the Paradox Gardens, researching their impact on the lifecycles and biology of the region's creatures. A specialist in aberrant biodiversity, she uses intricate and almost lifelike fractal models to extrapolate the evolution and adaptation of fauna to mana fluctuations. Many students have been known to wander for days simply seeking out the elusive professor's offices in the Paradox Gardens. Some suspect that this is part of Berta's analysis of the impacts of the gardens' phenomena on the students themselves.
Berta, Wise Extrapolator
Fractalize ( Secrets of Strixhaven )
Pterafractyl ( Secrets of Strixhaven )

Blech is a lazy and overweight pest . Son of the now-deceased Blex . Though Witherbloom students continue the tradition of a yearly search in Blex's honor, Blech's laziness and propensity to terrorize campus made him easy to find.

Emil is an elf druid and Quandrix student. He was born c. 4544 AR in the Grove of Eljor. He is particularly interested in the organization and planning of the wilderness. On campus, Emil is the leader of the Outdoor Urbanists, a group that specializes in venturing beyond campus and observing and measuring the natural world to develop formulas that will create more perfect environments.
Emil, Vastlands Roamer
Additive Evolution ( Secrets of Strixhaven )
Essence Scatter ( Secrets of Strixhaven )

Ennis is a human cleric and member of the Strixhaven debate team. Born between c. 4543 and 4546. As soon as he joined Silverquill , he joined the debate team. After he bested many exasperated professors in arguments, they encouraged him to take charge of the debate club and mentor other students in his skills and techniques.
Ennis, Debate Moderator

Excava is the animated statue of a war horse from the Blood Age. She served as a loyal and noble steed, riding into countless battles before perishing along with her rider in a major conflict at the Fields of Strife . Even as a spirit , Excava is a discerning war horse, only letting the most valorous ride her into battle. Many Lorehold students have attempted to summon her spirit and win her respect.
Excava, the Risen Past

Gorma is a pest frog . She was once a Witherbloom student's favorite pest, doted upon and fed all manner of treats. When the time came to consume Gorma for spells, the student couldn't do it, instead setting her free into the wilds of Titan's Grave. Gorma has since developed an appetite for basically anything and waits patiently for her next meal to wander past her open maw. Foolish students who visit Titan's Grave and attempt to capture her on a dare have never returned.
Margeau took the post of Silverquill 's white-aligned Dean of Radiance following Shaile Talonrook 's death in the New Phyrexian Invasion .
Reprieve ( Secrets of Strixhaven Mystical Archive )
Massimo is a cat magician . Their name and art reference the Magician tarot card.
Massimo, the Magician

Muddle is an unfinished Prismari otter elemental shapeshifter creation that has developed its own consciousness. As Muddle encounters the works of other students, it adapts and changes, incorporating new characteristics and increasing the complexity of its patchwork self.
Muddle, the Ever-Changing

Nita Aroste is a human advisor . A retired Silverquill professor, Nita is now a conciliator at the Forum of Amity. She still lectures as a guest on occasion, and her classes on diplomacy and negotiation are lauded as some of the best. She presented the talk "Water Right and Wrongs".
Nita, Forum Conciliator

Orysa is a merfolk bard and Prismari student. Born around 4544 AR in the Pinzari Isles, she is a master of group- elemental summoning , with a specialty in creating, sustaining, and directing a cadre of creatures. Water is her preferred medium, and she uses it not only in her summoning but also to augment the acrobatics of her performances. Her troupe, the Twirling Turtle Troupe, has been a highlight of the last few years of Summitfest . Orysa is preparing to graduate and take her show back to her home in Pinzari and beyond, hoping to become one of Arcavios's premier performers.
Orysa, Tide Choreographer

Page is a parchment construct . A piece of parchment that came to life, many students have tried and failed to catch the wayward sheet and discern its secrets. There are many rumors on campus about Page's origins. Some hypothesize it escaped from the Mystical Archive, while others believe it is an esoteric ritual straight from the Codex Vocifera . Others think that it is simply a Silverquill student's prank to get out of their homework.

Scriv is an inkling initially created at the Forum of Amity to moderate and enforce a particularly delicate diplomatic agreement. It was so effective at this that it now monitors most of the Forum's other contracts and treaties, having become something of a celebrity in the cutthroat world of document moderation.

Soovril is an orc cleric Lorehold student. Inspired by cross-disciplinary Quandrix classes on the manipulation of time, Soovril has continued to experiment with chrono-methodologies. He has developed techniques to restore historical artifacts to their original pristine conditions. Though slow and time-consuming, the results have aided the work of many of his fellow students.
Soovril, Patient Antiquarian
The following Arcavian characters are only mentioned in flavor text or appear as minor characters in the storyline.
